align.cite: AUTHOR'S CHOICE: the fixed jaw squared to 0.001 in (0.0254 mm) over 100 mm of the 6 in jaw because the shop test indicator (gauges.dti) reads 0.0005 in, so the limit is two graduations it resolves

hold.clamp: hand plus quarter turn, then tap the bar down onto the parallels with a soft hammer
hold.note: Bar flat on 1-1/4 in parallels, left side up; the jaw tops sit at Z -5.33, under the faced left side (Z0). Face the left side just enough to clean up: it is the reference face for every later setup.
hold.stop: No end stop: centre the bar in the jaws on the parallels.

findings.subject: P1

findings.message: P2: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: hold the round bar level against the moving jaw by hand, its centre at the Round bar line's height above the parallels, by eye (3 mm either way still seats the work), and close the jaw until it pinches the bar; hand plus quarter turn; tap the work down onto the parallels with a soft hammer
hold.note: Before clamping, file the burrs off the faced edges and wipe the bar, jaws and parallels. Bar on edge on 1 in parallels, the faced left side against the fixed jaw. The outer end comes out square to the left side.
hold.stop: No end stop: centre the bar in the jaws on the parallels.

findings.subject: P2

findings.message: P3: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: hold the round bar level against the moving jaw by hand, its centre at the Round bar line's height above the parallels, by eye (3 mm either way still seats the work), and close the jaw until it pinches the bar; hand plus quarter turn; tap the work down onto the parallels with a soft hammer
hold.note: Before clamping, file the burrs off the faced edges and wipe the bar, jaws and parallels. Bar on edge on 1 in parallels, the faced outer end down and the faced left side against the fixed jaw.
hold.stop: No end stop: centre the bar in the jaws on the parallels.

findings.message: P4: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: hand plus quarter turn, then tap the bar down until both parallels are pinned
hold.note: Before clamping, file the burrs off the faced edges and wipe the bar, jaws and parallels. Bar flat on 1-1/4 in parallels, the faced left side down. The right side comes out parallel to the left side.
hold.stop: No end stop: centre the bar in the jaws on the parallels.

findings.subject: P4

findings.message: P5: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: hold the round bar level against the moving jaw by hand, its centre at the Round bar line's height above the parallels, by eye (3 mm either way still seats the work), and close the jaw until it pinches the bar; snug, sweep the outer end with the DTI down its 30 mm and tap the work square; hand plus quarter turn
hold.note: Before clamping, file the burrs off the faced edges and wipe the bar, jaws and parallels. Bar standing on its sawn seat end on 5/8 in parallels, the faced left side against the fixed jaw.
hold.stop: No end stop: centre the bar in the jaws.

findings.message: P6: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: hold the round bar level against the moving jaw by hand, its centre at the Round bar line's height above the parallels, by eye (3 mm either way still seats the work), and close the jaw until it pinches the bar; hand plus quarter turn; tap the work down until both parallels are pinned
hold.note: Before clamping, file the burrs off the faced edges and wipe the bar, jaws and parallels. Bar standing on its faced crown end on 5/8 in parallels, the faced left side against the fixed jaw.
hold.stop: No end stop: centre the bar in the jaws, faced crown end down on the parallels.

findings.subject: P6

findings.message: S1: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

align.cite: AUTHOR'S CHOICE: the vise turned a quarter for the jaws along Y, its fixed jaw squared again to 0.001 in (0.0254 mm) over 100 mm of the 6 in jaw because the shop test indicator (gauges.dti) reads 0.0005 in, so the limit is two graduations it resolves

hold.note: Seat side up on 1 in parallels; blank X -9..9 and Y -4..22.2 in this Setup. Raw seat is Z +1, finished seat Z0. Finish the foot boundary only down to Z -6, leaving the ear-side stock below for S2-S4. Op 30 finishes the 24.2 mm foot length: its outer end at Y -3 is the finished outer face, while the ear below Z -6 keeps 1 mm on the outer end (Y -4) for S4 op 10. The foot-profile cut bottom (Z -6) stays clear of the jaw tops at Z -13.655.
hold.stop: No end stop: clamp the blank centrally over the parallels, then edge-find its left face and outer end for this Setup's X/Y zeros.

findings.subject: S1

findings.message: S2: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.note: Seat down on the 1-1/8 in parallels. The jaws grip the raw 18 mm overhang from the foot top up to Z +10.37; the finished 16 mm foot sits between the jaws without touching them. Rough only down to Z +16, clear of the jaw tops at Z +10.37. Before the X/Y pickups, touch the stationary edge-finder tip on the raw top (Z +27.2) with 0.05 paper and Axis Set Z 27.25 for a preliminary Z. Raise above Z +32 before every traverse between pickups. Touch the raw left side and free end with the tip at Z +20.
hold.stop: No end stop: seat the finished seat on the parallels, close the jaws on the raw overhang above the foot, then edge-find the raw left side and free end above the jaw tops for this Setup's X/Y zeros.

findings.subject: S2

findings.message: S3: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.note: Seat down on one pair of 1-5/8 in tall, 1/8 in thick ground parallels, keeping the X0 drilling line clear. Do not use 1-2-3 blocks between the jaws closed on this 16 mm foot. The jaws grip the foot from its bottom (Z -6) up to the jaw tops at Z -2.33; the foot top is Z0. The 6 mm foot is all there is to share: any more jaw clearance would come straight out of the grip, so keep the cutter at the printed levels and read the jaw clearance on each op before cutting. S2 already roughed everything above Z +16, so the roughing here starts no higher than Z +16. Retain a straight rectangular crown for S4, not an arch sculpted from above. Before the X/Y pickups, touch the stationary edge-finder tip on the crown top (Z +27.2) with 0.05 paper and Axis Set Z 27.25 for a preliminary Z. Raise above Z +32 before every traverse between pickups. S2 left the raw left side and free end standing only from the foot top (Z0) up to its Z +16 step: touch them with the tip at Z +8, between the jaw tops (Z -2.33) and the Z +16 step.
hold.stop: No end stop: seat the finished foot on the parallels and against the fixed jaw, clamp, then edge-find the raw left side and free end below the Z +16 step for this Setup's X/Y zeros.

findings.subject: S3

findings.message: S4: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

align.cite: AUTHOR'S CHOICE: the upright face that seats datum A squared to the X travel to 0.001 in (0.0254 mm) over 100 mm of its 127 mm length because the shop test indicator (gauges.dti) reads 0.0005 in, so the limit is two graduations it resolves

hold.clamp: fit the two bridge studs through the upright at Setup X +/-20, with the rear washers against the plate back and the rear nuts behind them; lay the bridge underside on the finished foot top at Setup Y -6, centred at Setup Z -17.5, and run the front washers and nuts down by hand until the bridge just holds the foot against the plate; indicate the exposed 4 mm seat lip with a small-ball DTI above the plate and tap the part until the lip sweeps flat

clamps.note: presses the foot toward the plate (+Y); bar top at Setup Z -11.15; studs, washers and nuts outside the foot width, clear of the foot-end ledge, arch and cross-bore; torque the two front nuts alternately with the 1/4 in drive torque wrench and 9/16 in socket

hold.locate: Seat the finished seat face flat against the angle-plate upright, outer face up and 4 mm proud of the plate top
hold.note: Recheck the seat lip with the DTI after full torque. Before the X/Y pickups, touch the stationary edge finder on the raw outer face (Z +1) with paper for a preliminary Z. For the final Z touch, look along X before lowering: the end mill must overhang the plate side of the seat and stand clear of the raised ear; a touch on the ear reads 1 mm high. Raise above Z +5 before every traverse between pickups.
hold.stop: Rest the foot free end on the bolted plate ledge at Setup Z -24.2, which carries the downward facing and drilling load; align the finished left foot edge at Setup X -8 before clamping.

findings.subject: S4

findings.message: S4F: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.clamp: close the bench vise on the stud tail, stud head up, with 20 mm of bare tail showing between the jaw tops and the head; drop the lower button over the stud onto the head; slide the cross bore over the stud, inner ear face down on the lower button; drop the upper button onto the outer face and run the M6 nut down by hand until it just seats the stack

clamps.note: M6 nut on the stud's 10 mm thread presses the upper button; the lower button seats on the stud head; torque with the 1/4 in drive torque wrench and 10 mm socket while one hand holds the foot against the turn
